recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Future clarification about BackboneElement or BackboneType should proceed under FHIR-52858 or another final work-group decision, not as part of FHIR-18350.
issue_request: FHIR-18350 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core extensibility change request to change the modifier-extension sentence from "at the base of a resource or in any elements..." to "at the base of a domain resource, in any elements...".
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit c46ff00cc7bffce09464c5e632054d767672c77c, which made the requested source/extensibility.html wording change. The current source still says modifier elements may appear at the base of a domain resource, in elements without a datatype, and on selected datatypes.
additional_context: source/extensibility.html is active current-build source because source/fhir.ini maps extension=extensibility. Later edits such as FHIR-25431's datatype spelling cleanup and the FHIR-18351 adjacent sentence split preserved the FHIR-18350 correction. A later Zulip thread and FHIR-52858 raise possible future BackboneElement clarity, but FHIR-52858 is Submitted/Unresolved and does not supersede this applied issue.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source already implements the final Jira decision, and no final later decision was found that changes the requested domain-resource wording.
